q: How does an Ambur tannery count boiler and effluent plant emissions?
title: Ambur tanneries: boiler and ETP emissions
short: Boiler fuel burned on site is Scope 1: coal, wood or oil times its factor. Electricity for drums, the effluent plant and dryers is Scope 2 at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25. A shared effluent plant you pay for is Scope 3; your own plant's electricity stays in Scope 2.
audience: Tanneries and finished leather units in the Ambur and Vaniyambadi cluster of Tamil Nadu

p: Coal in kg x 2.44 kg CO2 per kg (IPCC default for other bituminous coal), or wood handled as biogenic.
Electricity kWh x 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25.
Charges from a common effluent plant: Scope 3, from its operator's figure.
Divide by square feet or kg finished, and say which you used.

example.title: Worked example: one month (illustrative inputs)
lines: Boiler coal: 15,000 kg x 2.44 = 36,600 kg CO2
Electricity incl. own ETP: 20,000 kWh x 0.710 = 14,200 kg CO2
example.note: Quantities are illustrative; use your coal invoices and electricity bills.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
